definitions.explanation: A new blade bought to replace a worn one in a razor, a box cutter, a plane, or a similar tool.

examples.japanese: カミソリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{替|か}え{刃|ば}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。

⟦カッター→カッター：24215_kattaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れなく→切れる：01936_kireru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{替|か}え{刃|ば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The box cutter stopped cutting well, so I changed to a new blade.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧ (to replace) and ⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧ (blade); the ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ of ⟦{刃|は}→刃：09865_ha⟧ becomes ば.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {替|か}え{刃|ば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to change the blade
- カミソリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{替|か}え{刃|ば}: replacement razor blade
- {替|か}え{刃|ば}{式|しき}: with replaceable blades
- {替|か}え{刃|ば}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with spare blades included
